question: Why did Nvidia's net income jump in fiscal 2024?
summary: Nvidia's net income rose in FY2024: $4.37B -> $29.76B (+581.3%). The evidence is consistent with one driver: revenue grew in the same direction as profit. Only one independent driver was supported, so treat this as a partial explanation.
supported: Revenue grew in the same direction as profit

H6: Revenue grew in the same direction as profit

reference: Net income rose to $29.8B from $4.4B on revenue growth and gross margin expansion to 72.7% (NVIDIA FY2024 10-K).
